desc:
Wash ashore on a cozy wild island, make friends with its creatures and build the home of your dreams!

🐾 Tame cute creatures and keep them as pets. They follow you, help around your base and love a daily pat
🏡 Build your own house and decorate it room by room with furniture, rugs and lights
🌱 Grow crops, go fishing and cook warm meals
👗 Dress up in outfits and give your pets little hats
💛 Your home stays when you leave, so come back any time
👭 Play with friends in a private world, or join safe PvE worlds where nobody can attack you

Feeling brave? Explore caves and new lands when you're ready.

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to follow updates!
